groups.summary: Non-admin delete filter also matches system-owned repos, letting any user delete them
groups.reason: src/routes.ts:28 deleteRepo does no ownership check of its own. It passes req.params.id and req.user straight to Store.deleteRepo. In src/store.ts:29, the non-admin branch runs `DELETE FROM repos WHERE id = ? AND (owner = ? OR owner = 'system')`. Removing `OR owner = 'system'` from that one filter stops non-admins from deleting system repos through the route as well, so one change fixes both tickets. Any authenticated user can exploit this to delete shared repositories, which is an authorization bypass that loses data.
